item.title: Android Auto 16.0 update debuts as bug breaks message replies for some
item.description: Google has started the rollout of Android Auto 16.0 this week, but there’s a more pressing issue for some users as a bug is breaking support for message replies. more…

item.title: Hands-on: The Punkt MC03 might be the first privacy Android phone I’d actually try [Gallery]
item.description: Privacy often feels like an impossibility in the modern age of the internet, as your data is constantly tracked and shared by just about everything you do. That’s why privacy smartphones and privacy-focused forks of Android keep popping up. With the new Punkt MC03, though, I just found the first privacy Android phone I might be willing to try out. more…

item.title: Pixel Launcher rolls out search shortcut to quickly ‘open’ apps
item.description: After the 2022 removal and restoration for some users last year, Pixel Launcher search is once again letting you open apps using the keyboard. more…

item.title: Google Maps finally redesigns settings on Android

item.title: Hands-on: The Pebble smartwatch reboot looks great, but the Index ring is what I’m excited for [Gallery]
item.description: The Pebble smartwatch reboot is in full swing, with the Pebble Time 2 shipping soon and the newly-unveiled Pebble Round 2 not far behind it. After checking them out in person at CES 2026, I’m pretty stoked by the hardware, but it’s still the Index ring that makes me the most excited. more…

item.title: What new Google Messages features are rolling out [January 2026]

item.title: Smart glasses are better than ever, but the promise of Android XR is too close to ignore
item.description: Smart glasses have been the tech dream we’ve been chasing for years now, and the technology is finally getting there. Better displays, improved hardware, and an ever-growing list of platforms for smart glasses were on full showcase at CES 2026, but I can’t help but look at them with a mind to what’s coming next. more…
